scope: Exact NRO3917 original portrait fixture then Java UI, protocol1 captures and clean display handoff. Not external game proof.

receipt.capture_ownership_contract: Protocol1 runtime generation identity; matching pending request for CPU frames; identity rechecked after copy. Filesystem timestamps are not ownership evidence.

observed_sessions.scope: Diagnostic observation; final launcher result is required to verify completion and installation identity.
Diagnostic observation; final launcher result is required to verify completion and installation identity.

receipt.first_screen_contract: Runtime execution, fresh guest frames and safe return; a recognizable application screen requires visual review. This does not prove gameplay.

latest_memory_admission.scope: parser estimate is admission accounting, not an allocator measurement; memory.log contains allocator snapshots

manual_visual_review.method: Pixel-preserving Pillow PPM-to-PNG conversion, followed by view_image on native frame30 and Java last-frame. Original harness receipt is not rewritten.
manual_visual_review.portrait: Red/blue upper quadrants, green/yellow lower quadrants and vertical white moving marker fill 1280x720. Native callback buffers are 720x1280; this is the transformed GPU readback, not an independent compositor screenshot.
manual_visual_review.java: Landscape UI contains Ready 0 / app 1, Add and save, Open second activity, green square, yellow circle and Canvas / touch the square. Capture contains application UI, not the launcher.
manual_visual_review.input: No portrait touch or Java button interaction injected in this run.

capture_protocol: Real session/package/revision owner checked before and after copying; CPU additionally requires active pending request. No filesystem timestamp freshness assumption.
evidence_limits: Frame presentation and submitted pixel evidence are separate from final compositor output.
Only these two fixture scenarios are qualified; full M9 regression and game first screens remain open.
